# Independent audit: full-space mean without regularity

Audited source: `candidate 137cd11c6631be8a`, Sections 1–7. Verdict: PASS. No repair found. The objective is unpenalized and the local minimum is joint in bodies and parameters, as explicitly required.

## 1. Strict parameter change and exact cleanup

The set of proper-gap deepest marks is compact and stays in the own-fiber interiors. The finite-support extension of a continuous supporting normal gives depth zero at a fiber boundary, so positive deepest depth excludes all such boundary points. No regular-cap premise enters this interiority.

At a proper-gap mark an active cap is attained by finite tilt compression and has a proper own trace by the whole-fiber capture lemma. Lowering L at that mark strictly raises its fixed cap threshold within the own projection interval, losing positive OWN volume. Other fibers only lose volume. The source correctly uses this finite strip argument, rather than differentiating possibly supporting traces elsewhere.

Separation from the compact proper-mark convex hull gives one affine psi with zero inverse-power weighted mean and uniformly negative values on a neighborhood of all those marks. Exact negative-power normalization has first variation psi, uniformly on C. The source separates the two needed estimates correctly: a uniform old gap controls the complement of the neighborhood, while monotonicity and the own-strip argument give pointwise strictness inside it. Attainment of the NEW fiber maximum then makes the maximum strictly below Q; no invalid uniform loss is inferred from pointwise strictness alone.

Atomic bases remain bounded by their unchanged base caps; all other old bases retain strict gaps. If the parameter change leaves the global value equal, every surviving deepest base is atomic. The subsequent hinge erosion is an actual compatible body change. Keeping the old affine L and renormalizing by its new negative-power mean is legal and continuous on the eroded canonical body. This proves strict local descent without requiring a neutral path or cap derivative. The two stages can remain in the original minimum's neighborhood.

## 2. Equality, own status, and unique proper marks

The proper target cap's local strict tail makes its threshold the exact right Q-quantile. Input deepest marks therefore satisfy its correct quantile inequalities; averaging forces both f equality and equality in every input inequality. Full-space affinity gives L_r=sum lambda L_j even when the fiber marks move. Strict monotonicity of the weighted geometric mean then forces energy-root equality, while its equality condition makes F_j/L_j constant.

The established marked-homothety equality theorem applies to the actual whole fibers, including target inclusion. Consequently the common cap has precisely the same normalized own trace in every input. Properness at the target contradicts an atomic input's full own traces. This proves heredity without regularity, and the closed-minor/parity consequences follow from the already audited arithmetic proof.

For two proper deepest marks in the same fiber, their midpoint is deepest and proper-gap. The same equality chain would contradict strict fixed-body energy-root concavity. Combining that strict concavity with positive affine L preserves strictness of the composed f. Hence at most one proper deepest mark per base exists. This is an additional conclusion, not a premise concealed in the neighborhood argument.

## 3. Tilted-mean bijection and its limitation

For an arbitrary prescribed relative-interior point y of the fixed canonical body, the positive chart domain 1+a·(w-y)>0 is bounded because C contains a relative ball at y. Boundary approaches have a zero at a sampled fiber point, so the proved inverse-power divergence for r>=d makes the objective coercive. The unique minimizer is interior.

Strict convexity holds because a nonzero relative affine coefficient cannot vanish almost everywhere on every positive sampled fiber; those fibers span the stated relative space. Differentiation of the uniformly positive chart gives exactly the L^(-r-1)-weighted mean equation. Rescaling gives normalization, and conversely any normalized affine parameter realizing the prescribed mean yields the same stationary chart, hence the same unique parameter.

The explicit r=2 interval chart has product of endpoint numerator values y(1-y), giving inverse-square integral one; its inverse-cube mean is y. Thus the claimed limitation is exact: detached from joint minimality, the moment condition can select any interior point, even one of arbitrarily small ordinary depth.

The source correctly retains the changed continuous gradient a_E+grad_X L/(N L). Neither the mean inclusion nor the bijection restores energy optimality or a Gamma payment for that chart.

Reran `supporting computation verify_full_space_affine_negative_power_attainment_two_sided.py`: PASS, 819 exact checks. The nonregular compact-neighborhood and joint-descent arguments above are analytic, not inferred from finite samples.
